subject: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@polarishealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the intro this morning. I'd like to set up a 45–60 minute intake/discovery so we can bring the right folks from our side: a Solutions Engineer to walk architecture and an SE/Eng lead for technical scoping. From your note it sounds like Jamal will be the engineering champion on your side and procurement will need a quick run-through of licensing and SLA expectations.

Proposed agenda (attached as initial-agenda.pdf):
- 10m intros & goals
- 20m technical scenario + constraints (Jamal)
- 15m deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + security controls
- 10m procurement checklist & next steps

I have the following slots (PT):
- Wed 20 Jan — 09:30–10:30 or 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 21 Jan — 11:00–12:00 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows and we’ll pivot. I’ve cc'd Camila (SE) and Karthik (AE support) so they can confirm availability.

Attachments: initial-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@polarishealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@polarishealth.com>, procurement@polarishealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement

Hi Olga —

Thanks — that agenda looks good. Jamal will be our engineering champion. Procurement (procurement@polarishealth.com) wants a short preface on licensing models and any standard enterprise addenda you require. Also, security will need a SOC 2 summary and a short network diagram of the hosted offering prior to the call (they may not need the full diagram yet, but a high level topology helps).

We prefer no meetings on Fridays. Of your proposed times, Thu 21 Jan 11:00–12:00 PT looks best for Jamal and our procurement lead, but can you do it an hour later (12:00–13:00 PT)? If yes, we’ll confirm and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Claire Thompson
Director, Infrastructure — Polaris Health
claire.thompson@polarishealth.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@polarishealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@polarishealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement

Hi Claire —

We can move to Thu 21 Jan 12:00–13:00 PT. Camila (SE) will cover architecture and topology. I’m attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a mutual action plan that highlights typical deliverables and timeline (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Camila — can you confirm you and Karthik can hold Thu 21 Jan 12:00–13:00 PT? Also flag whether we should pre-share any diagrams or keep those for the live walkthrough (I can attach a 1‑page topology if security wants an advance look).

Docs attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (link), mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll prepare a brief procurement slide for the open items procurement usually asks about.

Best,
Olga

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@polarishealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement

Hi all —

Confirmed: I and Karthik can do Thu 21 Jan 12:00–13:00 PT. On the security diagram: I recommend a single-slide high-level topology that shows where inference workloads run (hosted vs dedicated), data flows, and encryption points. That should satisfy an initial triage. I’ll draft that slide and share it before the call unless Claire prefers we present it live.

Also, Jamal — if you can paste the primary integration points (S3/webhooks/VPC peering/etc.) that will help me tailor the walkthrough.

-Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@polarishealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@polarishealth.com>, procurement@polarishealth.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial intake: Polaris Health — discovery + security + procurement

Thanks — 12:00–13:00 PT on Thu 21 Jan works for us. Jamal notes our primary integration is S3 for bulk exports and an inbound webhook for real-time events; we’re evaluating VPC peering but not committed. Procurement would like to see your standard enterprise rate card and the DocuSign link for T&Cs in advance (procurement@polarishealth.com).

Procurement note: please send the rate card (pdf) and any standard addenda you expect to attach to SOWs or enterprise contracts.

We’ll expect the topology slide in advance (if possible).

– Claire
